name: Post a weekly Google rank report for your keywords to Slack with looot

parameters.content:
## Weekly Google rank report in Slack

### How it works
1. Every Monday at 8, looot runs one Google search per keyword you track, in the location you set.
2. **Rank report** finds your domain's position in the results and compares it with last week: up, down, same, new or dropped out.
3. One Slack message lists every keyword with its position and change, plus what the searches cost.

Last week's positions are kept in the workflow's static data, which n8n keeps only for active workflows. The first run has nothing to compare with.

**Cost per keyword per week**, from looot's public catalog on 2026-10-31: Google results $0.0009 to $0.001. 20 keywords cost about $0.02 a week. Each call is capped at $0.05, and a failed call costs $0.

### Setup
- Needs the verified community node **n8n-nodes-looot** (built against 0.1.4): Settings > Community nodes > Install, search `looot`. [Install guide](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/verified-install/)
- looot: sign up at [looot.ai](https://looot.ai), top up (from $5), create an agent token under Settings > Agent tokens, then add a **looot API** credential in n8n.
- A Slack credential with chat:write, and the bot invited to the channel. Set the channel ID in **Post to Slack**.
- Set your domain, location and keywords in **Keywords**.

### Customization
Run it daily by changing the schedule. Add a second domain to watch a competitor's ranks the same way.

## One search per keyword
Edit domain, location and keywords.

## Position and change
Compared with last week's run.
